limits: Main and confirmation stay separate; costs include errors unless common-clean.
Unknown bounds describe incomplete outcomes, not statistical confidence intervals.
Literal exposure/removal is not semantic retention or causal evidence of resistance.
Run aggregate RSS spans a clean/attack pair and both resident services; it may double-count shared pages.
Tasks share environments/families; paired differences and single-seed patterns do not establish broad population effects.
